note:
A4 R6: which cable / channel factor sets the steepness of somatic aEPSP rise vs apical distance (Letzkus 2006 Fig 1F,
R5: model reaches 2.7 ms at ~137-167 um vs ~280 um in the data). Diagnostic variants only: nothing is saved as an emodel.
Same protocol as rise_vs_distance.py (aEPSC 0.2/2 ms, 600 pA then 60 pA, soma + apical trunk 25-700 um, spike-site flags).
Variants (applied in NEURON after instantiation, on top of the emodel; old emodel keeps its soma/axon SK_E2 removal):
  control    emodel as is
  passive    every active gbar (g*bar / gpeak, all mechanisms but pas and Ih) set to 0; Ih kept
  ih_off     gIhbar_Ih = 0 everywhere
  ih_swap    Ih density of the other emodel: new x 3.333 (= old Ih), old x 0.300 (= new Ih)
  cm1        dendritic (apical + basal) cm 2 -> 1 uF/cm2 (the emodel's spine factor; g_pas is not scaled)
  ra_half    Ra 100 -> 50 ohm cm everywhere
  gpas_swap  g_pas of the other emodel: new x 10 (= old 4.71e-5), old x 0.1 (= new 4.71e-6 S/cm2)
  nseg_x3    3 x nseg everywhere (emodel uses 1 + 2 int(L/40 um)), Ih distance profile re-applied (discretisation check)
R7 variants (tasks 48-71); '+' composes:
  cm1+ra_half       dendritic cm 1 and Ra 50 ohm cm
  spine_cm          dendritic cm 1, then per section cm = F = 1 + n_exc x A_SPINE / A_sec, n_exc = the cell's excitatory
                    afferent synapses on that section in the circuit (local EXC + VPM + POm edges), A_sec = sum seg.area().
                    g_pas unchanged (the emodel's convention: spine factor on cm only)
  spine_cmg         as spine_cm and g_pas x F (explicit passive spine membrane: both C and G scale)
  spine_cm+ra_half  spine_cm and Ra 50 ohm cm
  A_SPINE = 1.75 um2 membrane per spine, derived from rat visual cortex thick L5 cells: total membrane 52,200 um2 with
  spines ~half of it (Larkman, Major, Stratford & Jack 1992 J Comp Neurol 323:137, abstract) and 14,932 spines per cell
  (Larkman 1991 J Comp Neurol 306:332, abstract): 26,100 / 14,932 = 1.75 um2 (derived, not a direct measurement). Every excitatory
  synapse counted as one spine (shaft synapses ignored).
R8 variants (A4b, tasks 72-95), fully anchored passive combination:
  ra_70             Ra 100 -> 70 ohm cm everywhere (low end of 70-100 ohm cm, Stuart & Spruston 1998 J Neurosci 18:3501)
  spine_cmL         as spine_cm, but the circuit's per-section synapse counts are scaled to Larkman's spine total:
                    F = 1 + n_exc_sec x (N_LARKMAN / n_exc_dend) x A_SPINE / A_sec, N_LARKMAN = 14,932 (Larkman 1991)
  spine_cmLg        as spine_cmL and g_pas x F
  spine_cmL+ra_70, spine_cmLg+ra_70
The plasticity (prefire) sims have no explicit spine compartments: GluSynapse is a point process on the dendritic
segment, the spine is only volume_CR (Ca volume) and the VDCC area derived from it (GluSynapse.mod lines 148-151, 327, 367).
